info.title: Vextorium — pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents
info.description: 200+ pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents: official statistics and economy (ECB, Fed, Eurostat, World Bank, SEC, BOE, INE), crypto prices and sentiment, Spanish public data, compliance (sanctions, VAT, IBAN, LEI), science, weather, web and developer tools and local AI text tools. Pay in USDC via x402.
info.x-guidance: Start here by task: crypto prices → /v1/crypto-price, /v1/crypto-convert and /v1/portfolio-valuation; compliance / KYB → /v1/sanctions-screening, /v1/wallet-sanctions-check, /v1/lei-search and /v1/eu-vat-vies; macro → /v1/economic-calendar, /v1/fed-rates, /v1/us-treasury-yield-curve and /v1/ecb-interest-rates; US companies → /v1/company-fundamentals and /v1/company-filings. Full workflows: https://api.vextorium.com/llms.txt. Every operation is a POST with a JSON body (see each requestBody example). The first call returns HTTP 402 with the x402 v2 challenge; pay in USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Optimism or Arc, or RLUSD or XRP on the XRP Ledger and retry the same request. Only successful (200) responses are charged; invalid input (4xx) or an unavailable upstream source (5xx) is never charged. Machine-readable catalog with real example outputs: https://api.vextorium.com/catalog.json. MCP server: https://api.vextorium.com/mcp
